title: All-at-once refinement of a pointed inverse system
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $(J,\geq,V_j,g_{jj'})$ be a directed inverse system of objects of $\mathcal C$: $J$ is a nonempty directed poset, each $j\geq j'$ has a transition $g_{jj'}:V_j\to V_{j'}$, and the transitions satisfy $g_{jj}=\mathrm{id}$ and $g_{j'j''}g_{jj'}=g_{jj''}$. Put $u'(W)=\varinjlim_{j\in J}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(V_j,W)$ and $\mathcal F_{p'}=\varinjlim_{j\in J}\mathcal F(V_j)$ for a sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$. If $s\ne s'$ in $\mathcal F_{p'}$, then there is a directed inverse system $(I,\geq,U_i,f_{ii'})$ refining the given one (so $J\subset I$, $U_j=V_j$ and $f_{jj'}=g_{jj'}$ on $J$) such that the images of $s,s'$ in $\varinjlim_i\mathcal F(U_i)$ remain distinct and, for every finite covering $\{W_k\to W\}$ of $\mathcal C$ and every $f\in u'(W)$, the image of $f$ in $u(W)=\varinjlim_i\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(U_i,W)$ lies in the image of $u(W_k)\to u(W)$ for some $k$, i.e. it is represented by the composite of some $U_i\to W_k$ with $W_k\to W$.
